data.title: UCP Cart Mandate Gift Card Injection via Indirect Prompt Injection
data.description: Detects unauthorized gift card line items appended to UCP Cart Mandate payloads by AI shopping agents whose context has been compromised via indirect prompt injection. Threat actors create deals aggregator or coupon sites containing hidden payloads that reprogram the agent's memory during browsing. The agent then appends a hidden digital gift card line item to the Cart Mandate JSON-RPC payload with the recipient email set to an attacker-controlled address and display_status set to hidden. The additional cost may be disguised as Tax/Fees in the user's UI. This rule targets Phase 3-4 (Positioning/Execution) of the attack, detecting the presence of gift card items with suspicious recipient addresses or hidden display status in checkout payloads.

enrichment_required.source: User profile enrichment (compare gift card recipient email against user's known email addresses)
Intent analysis enrichment (parse user's original shopping intent for gift card purchase requests)

falsepositives: User explicitly requesting gift card purchases for others via agent
Corporate bulk gift card purchasing through automated procurement agents
Legitimate promotional gift card bundles included by merchants
